title: Shopping with Anna
text:
Anna goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, eggs, bread, and apples. She puts everything in her cart.

Anna also needs rice for dinner. She finds the rice on the second shelf. Then she goes to the cash register and pays. She is happy because the list helped her.

questions.text: What day does Anna go to the supermarket?
What does Anna find on the second shelf?
Why does Anna use her shopping list?
What can we guess about Anna's dinner?

vocabulary.definition: a written set of things you need or want
a metal container with wheels used to carry shopping
a flat board on a wall or in a cupboard where things are put

paragraph_translations: Ana va al supermercado el sábado. Tiene una lista de compras en la mano. La lista tiene leche, huevos, pan y manzanas. Ella pone todo en su carrito.
Ana también necesita arroz para la cena. Ella encuentra el arroz en el segundo estante. Luego va a la caja y paga. Está contenta porque la lista le ayudó.
